card.name: Manic and impulsive symptom lists
card.fires_on: Words and commas inside lists of manic, hypomanic or impulse-control symptoms, such as racing thoughts, unusually grand ideas, euphoria, insomnia, gambling urges. It fires at the point just before the next symptom, often 'talking more'.

modes.label: Mania symptom list
modes.description: Words within the bulleted signs of mania or hypomania in bipolar warnings.
modes.example: severe problems sleeping racing thoughts reckless behavior<< unusually>> grand ideas excessive happiness or irritability talking

modes.label: Commas in examples lists
modes.description: Commas or 'e.g.,' within parenthetical lists of behavior or mood changes from sedatives or other drugs.
modes.example: hypomanic or manic symptoms (e.g., euphoria, insomnia<<,>> mood swings) during treatment

modes.label: Impulse urge lists
modes.description: Commas after gambling or sexual urges in impulse-control warnings.
modes.example: Ask patients about increased gambling urges<<,>> sexual urges, uncontrolled spending or other

card.writes: It seems to push toward words like 'talk', as in the next symptom 'talking more or faster'.
card.plain: It lights up in lists of manic or impulsive behavior symptoms, just before the next item.
